evidence.limits: Transcript is machine Whisper and garbles many lines (for example repeated '490 shekel' lines, names, 'כך אחד, כך שתיים'); wording below comes mostly from burned-in captions. Sheets are 1 frame per second so short captions and overlays between frames can be missed. Comment category counts are my rough tally over the 45 sampled comments, which are not representative. Cover looks like a generated or heavily edited image (briefcase of notes, retouched face), not a frame from the video; I cannot confirm how it was made. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Matan hands out cash to Instagram followers in Azrieli Mall; anyone who shows they follow him gets 490 shekels, and viewers are told to follow to have a chance.
audience: His existing and potential followers in Israel, anyone who may bump into him in a mall, people attracted by easy money.
caption_vs_video_note: Caption matches the video (cash handout to followers). The caption adds a giveaway mechanic not shown in the video (follow, tag a friend); his comments add share to story, tag him, for a 5,000 shekel draw.

opening.first_frame: Matan full body outside Azrieli Center, small mic in one hand, a stack of 200 shekel notes in the other, caption 'עם' over his torso.
opening.s0_1: Word-by-word caption 'עם' then at 0.25 s a hard cut to a close-up of the notes with '20,000₪' in big white text, held to about 1 s, then back to the wide shot with 'בוא'. He speaks to camera.
opening.s1_3: Wide shot, he looks at camera and smiles, captions 'נחלק / כסף / לעוקבים / שלי'. At about 2.25 s cut to him walking away from camera toward a security guard.
opening.s3_5: Handshake with a security guard (captions 'מצב? איתך הכל טוב?' with the guard's words in yellow), then 'אתה עוקב?' at about 4.0 to 4.25 s, 'כן' in yellow, 'תראה' at 4.75 s.
opening.visual_hook: A thick stack of 200 shekel notes in his hand and the '20,000₪' close-up in the first second, in a recognisable location (Azrieli).
opening.spoken_hook: Machine transcript 0-3 s: roughly 'I am with 20,000 shekels, let's hand out money to my followers' then a greeting.
opening.text_hook: עם / 20,000₪ / בוא / נחלק / כסף / לעוקבים / שלי (word-by-word, reads as one sentence).
opening.payoff_promised_at_s: about 2.0 (the sentence 'we split money to my followers' ends)
opening.works_without_sound: yes, because the notes, the number and the word-by-word captions carry the idea.

visual.subject_placement: Matan centred or on the right with the other person on the left or opposite; phone POV inserts with hands; captions in the vertical middle of the frame.
visual.setting: Azrieli Center mall: outside terrace, security tent, corridors, a glass-walled terrace, a food court, shop fronts, an escalator.
visual.lighting: Natural daylight outside and mixed daylight and mall lighting inside; handheld phone look, some frames overexposed.
visual.color_contrast: Matan in a light blue striped shirt and black trousers; soldiers in olive green; bright money notes. White captions with yellow and pink accents; green counter.
visual.props_and_gestures: Lavalier-style mic clipped to the shirt plus a small hand mic, stack of 200 shekel notes, counting notes into hands, pointing at phones, handshakes, showing his Instagram profile on a phone.
visual.supporting_footage: Phone POV close-ups of people's screens showing they follow him (about 6 s, 25 to 29 s, 39 to 42 s, 48 s, 54 to 57 s, 1:07 to 1:09), banknote graphics, a profile inset, an ad-like card for 'הפורטל' at 1:02 to 1:04.
visual.persistent_branding: A running green counter 'סך כסף שחולק' top right from 8 s; no logo bug or handle watermark seen.
visual.faces_blurred: yes (soldiers' faces blurred at 17 to 24 s and 29 to 31 s; some other participants are not blurred, for example the security guard, the lads at 1:12 to 1:17 and the diners)
visual.visual_progression: 0-1 s money close-up and wide; 2-5 s walk to security guard; 5-20 s first handouts with guard, counter starts at 8 s; 18-35 s soldiers in the mall, a coin and 10 shekels joke; 36-48 s food court table with POV phone checks; 50-60 s a soldier near a bakery, total 1,880; 1:05 'מחפש עוד עוקבים...' walk; 1:06-1:17 three young men, total 2,460; 1:18-1:22 Matan on an escalator speaking to camera.
visual.cover_matches_video: partly: same location, shirt and subject; the cover is a different composed image with a briefcase of money and big yellow text 'מחלק כסף לעוקבים'.
visual.ui_interference: Word-by-word captions sit mid frame (clear). The counter sits top right at roughly 10 to 12% of the height, at the edge of the top zone. The ad-like card at 1:02 to 1:04 and phone insets at 17 s and 1:17 sit in the lower-middle, partly in the bottom 35%.

editing.edit_function: Mostly clarity and information: banknote graphics next to amounts (200 at 8 s, 50 at 12 s, a fan of notes with each 490), the counter keeps the running total, POV phone shots prove the person really follows him. Confetti and the red X at 43 s are emotion and stimulation.
pacing_changes: t=0 to 2.3 s: very fast, three cuts in about 2.3 s
t=8 to 10 s: counter starts and the first handout plays at normal pace
t=19 to 24 s: sequence of soldier encounters, cuts about every 2 s
t=1:05 to 1:22: slower, the last scene runs about 15 s before the escalator talk
editing.ending: Last 3 s (about 1:19 to 1:22): Matan on an escalator talking to camera with captions 'להמשיך לי שתיראו תקבלו' (he says he will keep doing it and whoever sees him gets money). Counter shows 2,460₪.
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: people may re-watch to check the running total or to see if they recognise the location; no strong loop.

sound.delivery: Fast, energetic, street-interview style; loudness stays between about -14 and -22 dB for most of the Reel with a dip near -29 dB around 3 s and -31 dB around 9 s (short pauses between encounters).
sound.sync: Captions are word-by-word and line up with his speech; the counter updates after each handout; confetti appears when notes change hands.

text.colour_coding: White for Matan, yellow for the other person (guard, soldier), pink for emphasis words ('בבקשה', 'הזה?') and a green label 'יחידה מיוחדת' at 29 s; counter in white with the amount in green.
text.placement: Centre of the frame for captions; counter top right.
text.style: Bold sans serif, white with a dark shadow, one word at a time, large; amounts shown as '490₪' with the shekel sign.
text.density_and_read_time: One to two words at a time; always readable.
text.language: Short spoken Hebrew, slang and street banter ('הופה', 'אחי'), the amount 490 repeated many times; the word 'עוקב' recurs as the condition.
text.caption_structure: First line announces the giveaway with a money emoji; short lines with emojis; explains the condition ('אם אתם רואים אותי, תעצרו אותי'); ends with a numbered 3-step list (follow, tag a friend, get money) and a share-to-friend line; no hashtags.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew captions render correctly; numbers and the shekel sign appear in the expected order (for example '490₪'). Caption text begins with invisible direction marks.

story.setup: He announces 20,000 shekels to give to followers.
story.stakes: Will each stranger follow him; the counter shows the total growing.
story.progression: Encounter after encounter (guard, soldiers, diners, a soldier by a bakery, three young men) with a rising total from 200 to 2,460.
story.payoff: Each person who follows gets money; he repeats the invitation to the viewer at the end.
story.resolution: He says he will keep doing it and that whoever sees him gets money.
story.payoff_delivered: yes: he hands over cash repeatedly; the 20,000 is not reached on screen (counter ends at 2,460).
friction_points: t=about 34 to 35 s: coin gag and 'זוג' may confuse (interpretation)
t=1:02 to 1:04: the ad-like 'הפורטל' 490₪ card interrupts the giveaway flow (interpretation)
t=36 to 48 s: repeated phone checks, some repetition (interpretation)

explicit_prompts.wording: שלחו את זה לחבר שלא מפספס כסף קל

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 45 comments in endpoint order, not representative. Most are tags of friends or people saying they shared the Reel to their story. One notes 'החדים ישימו לב' that a man got 500 instead of 490 (a viewer noticing detail). One asks 'מתי ההגרלה מתן ?'.
engagement.creator_reply_pattern: His top comments set rules: profile open 24 hours so a story can be verified, check the story is up and tag him, follow the caption steps for a 5,000₪ draw.

conversion.offer: Cash for following (490₪ per person in the video) and a 5,000₪ draw in the comments.
conversion.proof: On-screen handovers, phone POV checking the follow, counter.
conversion.objection_handling: Phone POV shots to verify the follow is real.
conversion.urgency: Implied: he can appear in any mall at any time.
conversion.funnel_entry_visible: Follow his account; the caption lists the 3 steps for the 5,000₪ draw. A 'הפורטל' card at 1:02 shows a 490₪ product, a link to his own offer, not a CTA.
conversion.destination: Instagram profile shown on a phone inset; no link visible.

rights_and_privacy: No third-party film or TV; identifiable bystanders: yes (soldiers, mostly blurred; the guard, diners and three young men are not blurred); the Reel features soldiers in uniform on a mall floor, which LumeBook should avoid copying.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a big number and notes in the first second, a simple rule (follow and get 490), and a growing counter let anyone grasp the format without sound. Each encounter is a quick mini payoff with a different person, and the real mall location invites viewers to hope they meet him.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: the 20,000 promised is never reached on screen and the middle repeats similar handovers.

standout_moments.what: Cut to the note stack with '20,000₪' in the first second: money and proof in one frame.
The running counter 'סך כסף שחולק' starts: a simple scoreboard that gives progress.
A red X over a failed encounter: negative beat that adds variety.
Escalator close: he restates the invitation in the first person to the viewer.
